title: Ashfall Field Manual
summary: Stabilize water, shelter, route awareness, and salvage before deeper pushes.

blocks.title: Field Rule
blocks.body: Ashfall rewards short, deliberate loops. Scan the area, name the objective, mark a return line, take only what supports the next upgrade, and get home before thirst, weather, or inventory pressure makes the decision for you.

blocks.title: First Safe Win
blocks.body: A strong opening ends with drinkable water, a sheltered stash point, one marked route, light, and a small stock of salvage you can sort without standing in a hazard.

blocks.title: Route Rhythm
blocks.body: Run the same loop until it feels boring, then widen it. Each expansion should add one useful thing: cleaner water, better filtration, safer travel, a scanner read, a power repair, or a confirmed waypoint.

blocks.title: First Month Routes
blocks.body: Use the early route mission when you need a clear next objective without jumping straight into late-game pressure.
blocks.label: First Month Routes
blocks.subtitle: Starter route objective

blocks.title: Do Not Force A Bad Path
blocks.body: If the same route kills you twice, stop repeating it. Prepare for the hazard, shorten the trip, or approach from a cleaner landmark.
